summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented but unverified: I did not run tests, per instructions. Changes: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; six json.* theme keys in rich/default_styles.py; new rich/json.py with the JSON renderable and a main-guarded CLI; Console.print_json in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py (not added to __all__); docs (console.rst "Printing JSON" section, reference/json.rst, reference.rst toctree); CHANGELOG Unreleased entry; new tests/test_json.py. Choices: overflow set to None (the spec's "none" is not a valid Rich overflow value); the CLI guard imports Console inside the block; CLI read errors catch OSError and UnicodeDecodeError. The expected ANSI sequences in the styled test were derived by reading the style code and have not been executed. Nothing was committed.
